description_en: Send a VAML text message to the server. The digital human reads out the corresponding text and renders the video stream to the user
description_zh: 发送一个vaml文本消息给到服务端，数字人播报对应的文本，并渲染视频流给到用户
kebab_example: aliyun avatar send-vaml --tenant-id 5615 --session-id 76898bd3b90b4a65b1c078d8824a2e9c --vaml '参考文档' --region cn-hangzhou
name: SendVaml

parameters.help_en: Tenant ID, obtained from the digitized virtual human Open Platform
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，从虚拟数字人开放平台中获取的TenantId
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: Session ID. You can obtain it from the return value of the "Start a digital human" API
parameters.help_zh: 会话 SessionID。通过“启动一个数字人”API的返回值获取
parameters.name: session_id

parameters.help_en: VAML protocol request. For details, see the official document (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/444010.html?spm=openapi-amp.newDocPublishment.0.0.37e9281fRBn9wz)
parameters.help_zh: VAML协议请求，具体参考官方文档 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/444010.html?spm=openapi-amp.newDocPublishment.0.0.37e9281fRBn9wz)
parameters.name: vaml

Code.description_en: Code corresponding to the processing abnormality

UniqueCode.description_en: Unique code of the request, corresponding to the uniqueCode in the VAML content
UniqueCode.description_zh: 请求唯一code,对应vaml内容中的uniqueCode

Message.description_en: Description corresponding to the processing abnormality
Message.description_zh: 返回处理异常对应描述
